Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human Cytochrome P450 2D6 (CHEMBL289). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, join assays to target_dictionary on tid, and join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL289. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
